findings.title: Exported API function returns Promise<any>
findings.explanation: `getUser` is exported and returns `any`, so every caller loses type checking for the response.
findings.evidence: export async function getUser(id: string): Promise<any> {
findings.suggested_fix: Return `Promise<User>` after validating the response, or `Promise<unknown>` and narrow at the call site.

findings.title: Stored JSON is double-cast to User
findings.explanation: `JSON.parse(raw as string) as unknown as User` forces unvalidated storage data into `User`, and also casts a possible null to string.
findings.evidence: return JSON.parse(raw as string) as unknown as User;
findings.suggested_fix: Check `raw` for null and validate the parsed shape before returning it as `User`.

findings.title: Non-null assertion on Map.get
findings.explanation: `Map.get` returns undefined when the key is absent, so this throws a TypeError if there is no admin entry.
findings.suggested_fix: Handle the missing case explicitly, e.g. `users.get("admin")?.email`.

limitations: Expected result for the evaluation harness; labelled by the maintainers.
